$comment: Source rows that no research pass recorded, added because a corpus source reads them. `buildSourceRegister` reads each row after the research CSV's rows, in the CSV's own columns, so its id and license scope come from the same derivation. Every row here but two reads `CORPUS INPUT, TERMS UNREAD`, which derives an `unchecked` decision: the row exists so that the gap shows in the register rather than hiding as an absence. The two exceptions, Poste Maroc's and 4-72's post-office lists, are official post-office lists no corpus source reads, because their share-alike grants are refused by the share-alike-free license policy; they read `Free` and record that outcome in their decisions. rows.authority_basis: The IDE, the national spatial data infrastructure under Presidencia de la República, publishes the national geographic address points

rows.authority_basis: The Landesverwaltung keeps the official index of building addresses (amtliches Gebäudeadressverzeichnis) and publishes it on its geodata download service

rows.authority_basis: The Land Registry records every registered transfer of land on the Isle of Man and publishes the transactions as open data

rows.authority_basis: The Grand Bahama Port Authority administers the City of Freeport under the Hawksbill Creek Agreement and assigns its street addresses
